name: Question 11
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945962/assets/94807e919e7e2cb3f281e53de88334bd6d50dadb1de93beb2a8adc04148c5756.png)

The speed-time graph shown above represents the motion of an ostrich. At what times is the ostrich decelerating?
worked_solution:
The ostrich is decelerating when its acceleration is negative. In a speed-time graph, the acceleration is given by the slope of the line. So, we need to find the times for which the slope is negative.

We see from the graph that the slope is negative from $t=5\,\text{s}$ to $t=8\,\text{s}.$ Therefore, the ostrich is decelerating in this time interval.

Question 11
?

The speed-time graph shown above represents the motion of an ostrich. At what times is the ostrich decelerating?

a
From 5s to 8s
b
From 8s to 10s
c
From 0s to 5s
d
From 5s to 10s
e
From 0s to 8s
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The ostrich is decelerating when its acceleration is negative. In a speed-time graph, the acceleration is given by the slope of the line. So, we need to find the times for which the slope is negative.

We see from the graph that the slope is negative from t=5s to t=8s. Therefore, the ostrich is decelerating in this time interval.
